high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from Softonic, a website that provides news and reviews about technology and software. The time displayed at the top of the screen is 04:55, and there are various icons indicating connectivity status and battery level. The main content of the page discusses a partnership between Alibaba (represented by Taobao) and a Beijing-based startup called Space Epoch. The text mentions that Space Epoch used its WeChat account to confirm plans for launching rockets, specifically detailing a 120 m³ cargo cabin mounted on their Yuanxingzhe 1 rocket.
